[[Reflections Gold|Original set]] · [[Reflections Gold Remastered|Remastered set]] · [[Reflections Gold (original card list)|Original cards]] · [[Reflections Gold (remastered card list)|Remastered cards]]

The remaster improves the images and makes minimal corrections to obvious lore and game-text problems, while preserving the original designs and intentional blanks.

This comparison shows 95 cards and 98 changed fields. The images are paired below; the summary and reason identify each difference. Mechanical changes and apparent regressions requiring a decision are marked for review. Full wording is on each card’s page.
